video.title: AI欧腐《天使王的祭品王子/The Angel King Wants My First Night》
video.desc:
Human prince Edric is sacrificed to the cursed Angel King Michael. Michael sees him as a cure; Edric hates angels. But as they grow close, love blooms—while the curse’s backlash may soon take Edric’s life.

人类王子 Edric 被作为祭品献给受诅咒的天使王 Michael。Michael 将他视为解咒的"药"，而 Edric 对天使恨之入骨。可随着两人渐渐靠近，爱意悄然滋长——而诅咒反噬的代价，或许很快就会夺走 Edric 的生命。
